comment: The dither input is dead. src/Organism.cpp:255 reads FAMT_INPUT, the filter amount jack, when it works out the dither, so the dither jack is never read at all and the amount jack drives both. Left untagged, clicking the dither jack would answer with the maker's tooltip, 'Dither', which is untrue. The maker's manual calls this module Domesticate, and its source file is src/Domesticate.cpp; the panel and the model slug both say O-Tamer. The module has no process method of its own, so its parameters and jacks exist only to be read by Organism through getLeftExpander.
